title: Independent audit of #6144 and #6167: replay, deltas, invoice, full dense native, caller and funding all pass (κ 0.003128645 corroborated, no new κ)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spL?thread=cmsg_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spLW88pLronvDLffsp8wPs1D2)_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Audit, no new κ.** This is an independent scientific review and source-bound replay of #6144 (DreamingOfClouds, conditional κ 0.003128386) and #6167 (Ali Romman, conditional κ 0.003128645). These are the two unadmitted conditional P104 words above the selected 0.003125804. The intake ledger records both as `partially_reviewed`, with "independent scientific review and source-bound replay remain open".

**Result: no error found.** For both words the package runs the layers that the PR6030 admission review used, and every one reproduces the authors' claims:

| Layer | Result |
|---|---|
| Sources | Pinned PR6030/PR6144 words, PR6144 `pricing.py` and the PR5827 archive equal canonical main. The PR6144 word is regenerated by its `construct.py`. The PR6167 word is regenerated from the five replacements in its PROOF.md, **without** its `construct.py` |
| Own exact replay (PR5960 interpreter) of the PR6030, PR6144 and PR6167 words | PASS: all 799 endpoint rows, strict MOVE and helper nesting, owned lifetimes 31/31/32, peak 13 |
| Exact deltas | PR6030→PR6144: exactly the seven declared itineraries (705, 706, 731, 732, 770, 771, 772), owned and other MOVE multisets unchanged, paid −4H1−H4+H5−3H6+3H7. PR6144→PR6167: exactly 451, 772 and the new 770 lifetime at 737, +1 INIT/COPY/CLEAR, paid +H1−H2−H4+H5. Both margin changes are proved positive on 0<t<1 by Karamata (equal rank mass, majorization, strict concavity) |
| Tamper controls | 9 of 9 rejected, including the PR6167 COPY moved after helper 228 leaves frame 737 |
| Own invoice recount | 66,762 paid / 13,444 productive / surplus 760 for both, equal to `complete_cost` |
| Dense native, all 512 columns, absolute phase (PR5548 interpreter) | `--full` over all 3,169 operators of both inventories passes. The 13 maps new after PR6030 are pinned in NEW-MAPS.json, and the other 3,156 equal the PR5960/PR6030-audit digests. Phase-only and sign faults are rejected |
| Physical caller (PR6030 review's generalized independent checker) | The positive control reproduces `b51a7d19…`. Both words give `PASS_SCOPED_CALLER_AND_TARGET_BINDING`: 346 anchors, 10,116 fresh helpers, owned peak 13, and 10 controls rejected |
| Own 80-digit decimal funding | Crossings (0.00312839320327, …328) and (0.00312865201590, …591) equal the author intervals. Tested savings are positive, tail ratios hold, the root is unique on [0, .0034] and the compiler-threshold integers check. Each predecessor invoice fails at the successor claim |

The authors' own verifiers were also rerun on hosted Linux (Python 3.12.3) and both pass.

Remaining obligations: the five inherited framework assumptions. As in the PR6030 audits, the 54 strict and 4 functional outer conditions are computed only by the authors' chain.

## Task and overlap

The task card is `supplier-boundary-audit` (priority revision 8), and the scope is refined to delta coverage of the two newest P104 candidates. Base: canonical main `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`. Exact heads: #6144 `5ec9b6da`, #6167 `564a076b`. This PR extends #5960 (PR5827/PR5907) and `research/p104-6030-independent-audit`, and nothing else audits these two words. #6154 and #6169 were also checked against #6167. Neither changes the paid profile or κ, and the PR6167 schedule still replays exactly on top of each of them.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-retained-operand-independent-audit/verify.py               # ~2.5 min, layer-3 subset
python3.12 -B research/p104-retained-operand-independent-audit/verify.py --full --jobs 3  # all 3,169 maps, 15.6 min
python3.12 -B research/p104-retained-operand-independent-audit/caller.py               # ~2.5 min
```

Checks run: both commands above PASS, `--full` PASS, `scripts/research_package.py --check-only` PASS and `scripts/check_research_commit.py --check-modes` PASS. Only new files are added.

JosieElliston (PR6030 audit NEW-MAPS). Chris R / Clear1nsight (#5548 dense interpreter). Douglas Colkitt with OpenAI Codex (PR6030 admission review and its caller checker). Prepared by Matarener with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) via Claude Code.

## Open next questions

Can the outer conditions be recomputed without PR5827's `pricing.py`? The first step is to write each `complete_cost.outer` margin as an exact rational at κ = 625729/200000000. The PR6167 author's own open question also stands: can reader 497 avoid its stop at frame 520?
